newsitem.title: USA: Insilco expects Q4 gains and charges.
newsitem.headline: Insilco expects Q4 gains and charges.

text.p: Insilco Corp said on Thursday that it is expecting a pre-tax restructuring charge of about $1.5 million in the fourth quarter to pay for a 15 percent staff reduction in its specialty publishing unit.

The company also expects a pre-tax gain in the fourth quarter from selling its Rolodex electronic organizer product line. The gain should be between $3 and $4 million, net of related fees and expenses, the company said.
